title: Squad analysis
intro: Import your squad, pick the formation you play, and see your first and second eleven, where the squad is thin or weak, who is ageing out and which youngsters can step up.

import.title: Import your squad
import.titleCount: {count, plural, one {# player in your squad} other {# players in your squad}}
import.description: Export your squad screen with the <squad>Squad</squad> or <hidden>Squad Hidden Attributes</hidden> view (adds potential). Kept separate from your scouting import.
import.noColumns: This import has no squad columns, so loans, injuries, squad status and the team sheet are not checked.

noImport.desktop: No squad yet. Every scan reads your own club's players too.
noImport.web: No squad imported yet. Choose your squad CSV above, or load the test data to look around.
noImport.usePlayerImportPrompt: Already exported your squad as the player import?
noImport.usePlayerImport: Use the player import ({count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}}) as your squad

setup.title: Setup
setup.loanHint: {count} out on loan at other clubs.
setup.injuredHint: {count} injured now. On: the elevens you can pick today.

cannotFill.title: Your squad cannot fill this formation.
cannotFill.body: Nobody plays {positions} as a natural position, so the eleven is short. Only natural positions from the export count.

footnote: Each position is scored on its role (1–20, with the S++ to F grade) and only counts players who list it as a natural position. The first eleven has the highest total score; the second eleven is the best eleven from everyone left, so each player covers one position.

stars.title: {hasLabel, select, yes {{label}: {value} stars} other {{value} stars}}

legend.click: Click a position to see its notes.

overview.nothingToFix: Nothing to fix: every starter is close to the eleven's average and has cover less than 1.5 behind them.

fix.title: Fix
fix.blurb: Positions that cost you now: gaps, weak links and thin cover.

manage.title: Manage
manage.blurb: Squad status that does not match the eleven. Sort it out at the next contract talk.

develop.title: Develop
develop.blurb: Young players who will outgrow a starter, and successors ready to step in.

statusStarting.advice: Starts here on a low status. Raise it when you next talk contracts.

no-fit.blurb: No natural position in this formation.
